instructions: Complete the summary using the list of words and phrases, A-J, below.
stem_block:
Sleep, naps and remembering word pairs

Two studies asked how well freshly learned word pairs survive either a night of sleep or a short daytime rest. In the earlier one, different volunteers were placed in a sleeping group and a waking group; the later one instead used a (36) ........ design, so that the very same volunteers went through both a rest and a matching stretch of time without one. In the earlier study, one group met 80 pairs late in the evening and was tested twelve hours afterwards, while the other met them at the start of the day and remained (37) ........ until an evening test. Where the two halves of a pair were already (38) ........ , a whole night of sleep improved recall far more than a rest of an hour and a half did. Where no such link existed, however, the picture changed: the two turned out to offer (39) ........ . Neither how long a rest ran nor which stages it contained predicted the size of the gain; what counted, the authors argue, was (40) ........ rather than anything about the internal shape of the sleep.

items.prompt: In the earlier one, different volunteers were placed in a sleeping group and a waking group; the later one instead used a (36) ........ design, so that the very same volunteers went through both a rest and a matching stretch of time without one.
items.evidence: The first experiment used a between-subjects design, meaning that different participants were assigned to a sleep group or a wake group, while the second used a within-subject design in which the same participants experienced both a nap and a period of wakefulness on different days, allowing more direct comparison.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the second experiment used a 'within-subject' design in which the same participants experienced both the nap and the period of wakefulness; so the correct option is J.
items.flag_reason: Cevap J ('within-subject'), cumlenin kendisi bosluktan hemen sonra terimin tanimini veriyor ('the very same volunteers went through both...'); kelime bankasindaki karsit terim C ('between-subjects') farkli katilimcilari gerektirdigi icin bu tanimla celisiyor, boylece terim parcaya bakmadan da secilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Bosluk 'within-subject' terimini hedefliyor ve bu terimin Ingilizcedeki tek tanimi 'ayni katilimcilar her iki kosuldan da gecer'. Ikinci deneyi durustce anlatan her ozet bu tanimi vermek zorunda, yani tanim sizintisi cerceveden degil boslugun hedefinden geliyor. Ustelik ayni ozetteki 37. cumle ilk deneyin iki ayri gruptan olustugunu soyluyor; bankadaki karsit terim C ('between-subjects') boylece ilk deneye baglanip eleniyor ve J elemeyle cikiyor. Tanimi ozetten silmek kalan cerceveyi anlamsiz birakiyor; bankadaki C'yi degistirmek ise J'yi bankadaki tek arastirma-deseni terimi haline getirip sizintiyi buyutuyor. Tek cikis boslugu baska bir ayrintiya tasimak, o da answer'i degistirmek demek - talimat bunu yarim duzeltme sayiyor. E6 bu yuvayi B ya da D paragrafinin baska bir ayrintisina capalamali (haftada en az bir kez sekerleme yapan 34 katilimci, ya da sersemligi azaltmak icin uygulanan 30 dakikalik bulmaca).

items.prompt: In the earlier study, one group met 80 pairs late in the evening and was tested twelve hours afterwards, while the other met them at the start of the day and remained (37) ........ until an evening test.
items.evidence: The wake group learned the same material at nine in the morning and were tested twelve hours later, at nine that evening, having remained awake throughout.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the wake group learned the material at nine in the morning, was tested twelve hours later at nine that evening, and had remained awake throughout; so the correct option is B.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'stayed ___ until an evening test' kalibinin ucunda; 'stayed awake' Ingilizcede kaliplasmis bir ifade oldugu icin, kelime bankasindaki karsit secenek 'a chance to sleep' bu kaliba uymadigindan parcaya bakmadan da 'awake' tahmin edilebiliyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: In the earlier study, one group met 80 pairs late in the evening and was tested twelve hours afterwards, while the other met them at the start of the day and stayed (37) ........ until an evening test.
revision.ne_degisti: 'stayed ___' kalibi ('stay awake' esdizimi) 'remained ___' ile degistirildi ve kelime bankasindaki H secenegi ('the length of the nap' -> 'in the laboratory') ayni cerceveye oturan gercek bir rakip yapildi. Artik iki secenek de dilbilgisi ve anlam bakimindan uyuyor; secim C paragrafina bagli.

items.prompt: Where the two halves of a pair were already (38) ........ , a whole night of sleep improved recall far more than a rest of an hour and a half did.
items.evidence: For semantically related word pairs, nocturnal sleep produced a substantially larger improvement in recall than daytime napping did, with a standardised effect size of 0.58 compared with only 0.15 for napping.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says nocturnal sleep's clear advantage over napping showed up for semantically related word pairs; so the correct option is D.
items.flag_reason: Cevap D ('connected in meaning'), uykunun bellek pekistirmedeki katkisinin anlamca iliskili/cagrisimli bilgilerde daha guclu oldugu bilissel bilim bilgisiyle parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor; kelime bankasindaki karsit secenek I ('unrelated in meaning') bu ozelligin tam tersini tasiyor.
items.reject_reason: Sorunun ekseni, uykunun hangi tur malzemeyi daha cok kayirdigi - bilissel bilimin en cok aktarilan bulgularindan biri - ve kelime bankasi bu ekseni hazir bir zit cift olarak tasiyor (D 'connected in meaning' / I 'unrelated in meaning'). Ustelik hemen ardindan gelen 39. cumle 'Where no such link existed' diyerek 38'in 'baglantili' taraf oldugunu soyluyor, yani I ozetin kendi ic mantigiyla de eleniyor. Bosluk nasil yazilirsa yazilsin secim iki kutuptan birini isaretlemeye iniyor ve karar pasajdan degil dunya bilgisinden geliyor; kip ya da cerceve duzeltmesi bunu kapatmaz. E6 bu yuvayi E paragrafinin pasaja ozgu bir ayrintisina tasimali (0.58'e karsi 0.15 etki buyuklugu, ya da 40 iliskili + 40 iliskisiz cift bolusumu).

items.prompt: Where no such link existed, however, the picture changed: the two turned out to offer (39) ........ .
items.evidence: For unrelated word pairs, however, nocturnal sleep and napping produced very similar benefits, with effect sizes of 0.71 and 0.68 respectively, showing that a nap could match a full night's sleep when the material being learned had no prior connection to existing knowledge.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that for unrelated word pairs nocturnal sleep and napping produced very similar benefits, with effect sizes of 0.71 and 0.68; so the correct option is F.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'produced almost (39)___' kalibinda; 'almost' (neredeyse) sozcugu yakinlik/esitlik bildiren bir ifadeyle dogal olarak eslesiyor, kelime bankasindaki 'much weaker results' ise buyuk bir farki ima ettigi icin bu kalipla celisiyor -- bu dilbilgisel uyum yalniz 'equal benefits'i birakiyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Where no such link existed, the two produced almost (39) ........ .
revision.ne_degisti: 'produced almost ___' kalibindaki 'almost' kaldirildi: 'almost' yakinlik bildirdigi icin bankadaki tek yakinlik ifadesini (F) isaret ediyor, G'yi ise dilbilgisiyle eliyordu. Yeni cercevede G ('much weaker results') de dilbilgisi ve anlam bakimindan uyuyor.

items.prompt: Neither how long a rest ran nor which stages it contained predicted the size of the gain; what counted, the authors argue, was (40) ........ rather than anything about the internal shape of the sleep.
items.evidence: Neither the exact length of a nap nor the particular stages of sleep it contained showed any significant relationship with how much memory improved, suggesting that simply having the opportunity to nap mattered more than its precise internal structure.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says that neither the length of a nap nor the sleep stages it contained showed a significant relationship with the memory gain, and that simply having the opportunity to sleep mattered more than the nap's internal structure; so the correct option is A.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'simply getting (40)___ counted for more...' kalibinda; 'getting a chance to X' Ingilizcede yerlesik bir ifade oldugu icin, sekerlemenin ic yapisindan degil firsatin kendisinden soz edildigi bu kalip parcaya bakmadan da 'a chance to sleep'i isaret ediyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Neither how long a rest ran nor which stages it contained predicted the size of the gain, which suggests that simply getting (40) ........ counted for more than the internal shape of that sleep.
revision.ne_degisti: 'simply getting ___' kalibi ('get a chance to ...' yerlesik esdizimi) kaldirildi ve kelime bankasindaki E secenegi ('deeper sleep' -> 'an unbroken night') bu cerceveye oturan gercek bir rakip yapildi; 'deeper sleep' zaten uykunun IC YAPISI oldugu icin cumlenin kendisiyle celisiyor, yani rakip sayilmiyordu.
